articles.author: Jenny Lee
articles.title: Alibaba plunges after announcing $10.2 billion share placement to fund AI push - CNBC
articles.description: Alibaba shares plunged 10% after the tech giant priced a $10.2 billion share placement to fund its growing AI investments.
articles.content: Alibaba shares plunged as much as 10% in Hong Kong on Monday after the Chinese tech giant priced an 80 billion Hong Kong dollar ($10.20 billion) placement of newly issued shares to non-U.S. investors… [+1476 chars]
